title: RAGuard: A Layered Defense Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems Against Data Poisoning
authors: Pushkal Kumar; Tucker Nielson; Tanish Kolhe; Shubham Zala; Vincent Li
impact: 当前系统允许导入外部文本但只有元数据准入；该工作支持增加语料投毒红队、异常检测和高风险片段的反事实影响测试。

title: PatientAgentBench: A Benchmark Framework for Evaluating Patient-Facing Health AI Agents
authors: Korosh Vatanparvar et al.
impact: 1200 个持续对话工具场景显示静态 QA 无法暴露分诊、工具结果核验、危机资源遗漏和虚构动作等故障。

title: Agentic AI in medicine: architectures, applications, evaluation, and challenges for clinical translation
authors: Zheng Tong et al.
impact: 系统映射 557 项研究，指出真实工作流、过程可靠性、证据追踪、安全、外部有效性和前瞻验证仍不足。

title: Meaningful oversight of medical AI beyond human in the loop
authors: Davy van de Sande; Nicoleta Economou-Zavlanos; Michel E. van Genderen
impact: 人工在环只有在具备知识、时间、决策权和真正可暂停/撤销的技术控制时才是有效安全机制。

title: Retrieval-augmented generation in medicine: A scoping review of technical implementations, clinical applications, and ethical considerations
authors: Rui Yang et al.
impact: 医学 RAG 仍偏英文、公有数据和静态任务，对临床验证、跨语言、低资源、安全与偏差评测投入不足。

title: Addressing benchmarking gaps in large language models for health and medicine with dynamic red-teaming
authors: Jiazhen Pan et al.
impact: 动态红队发现 94% 的原本正确答案在鲁棒性变体下失败，支持把隐私、偏差、幻觉和扰动变成持续门禁。

title: DS@GT ARC at LongEval: Citation Integrity and Factual Grounding in Scientific QA
authors: Brandon Michaels; Brendon Johnson
impact: 答案相关性和流畅性可与实际使用证据脱钩；生成前过滤和生成后严格蕴含核验更接近可信 RAG 目标。

title: Evaluating and Guarding Citation Faithfulness in Agentic Scientific Synthesis
authors: Taewan Goo; Junsik Kim; Kyulhee Han; GwonYul Jo; Jong-Soo Kim; Tae-Hyung Kim
impact: 同一输出的不支持引用率可因 verifier 严格度从约 3% 变为约 18%，要求金标准校准、命名协议和置信界。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Abstention in Large Language Models with Provable Alignment Guarantees
authors: Sijin Dong; Hiroyuki Shinnou
impact: 将任意不确定性分数转换为有限样本风险受控的选择性回答规则，适合替代当前无校准的证据状态路由。

title: Efficiency vs. Verifiability in Evidence-Aware RAG: Does Prompt Compression Preserve Citation Grounding?
authors: Aiyu Li; Qian Peng; Bin Chen
impact: 上下文压缩可能保住答案质量却损坏引用 grounding，成本优化必须同时守住证据指标。

title: HealthAgentBench: A Unified Benchmark Suite of Realistic Agentic Healthcare Environments for Challenging Frontier AI Agents
authors: Qianchu Liu et al.
impact: 54 个端到端医疗环境任务中最强系统成功率仍约 42%，支持环境级、执行级而非只看文本答案的评测。

title: SEMA-RAG: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Medical Reasoning
authors: Yongfeng Huang; Ruiying Chen; James Cheng
impact: 将临床语义解释、充分性驱动检索和证据裁决解耦，在五个 benchmark 和五个模型上平均提升 6.46 个准确率点。

title: AgenticRAGTracer: A Hop-Aware Benchmark for Diagnosing Multi-Step Retrieval Reasoning in Agentic RAG
authors: Qijie You; Wenkai Yu; Hao Liang; Zhen Hao Wong; Wentao Zhang
impact: 逐跳诊断揭示过早收敛和过度延展；当前项目只有最终任务状态，缺少查询/证据/推理 hop 的正确性标注。

title: Agentic-R: Learning to Retrieve for Agentic Search
authors: Wenhan Liu et al.
impact: 多轮检索器应同时优化局部相关性和最终答案正确性，而非只优化相似度；直接对应当前检索与答案脱钩。

title: LLM-Generated Text May Harm Your Retrieval! A Robust Detection Strategy for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Zhaoheng Huang; Yutao Zhu; Ji-Rong Wen; Zhicheng Dou
impact: 模型生成文本污染外部语料会降低长期检索质量，来源治理需要内容来源标记和污染检测。

title: RIPRAG: Hack a Black-box Retrieval-Augmented Generation Question-Answering System with Reinforcement Learning
authors: Meng Xi et al.
impact: 黑盒反馈即可优化投毒文档并显著提高攻击成功率，说明只做来源元数据治理不足以覆盖导入知识风险。

title: PhysicianBench: Evaluating LLM Agents in Real-World EHR Environments
authors: Ruoqi Liu et al.
impact: 100 个真实咨询改编的长程 EHR 任务平均需 27 次工具调用，最强模型 pass@1 仅 46%，强调执行检查点和结果状态验证。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Tool-Calling Agents in Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR)
authors: Marius S. Knorr; Robert Mueller; Jan P. Bremer; Nils Schweingruber
impact: FHIR 图上的执行约束和奖励训练将正确率从 50% 提至 77%，支持增加结构化 EHR 端口和确定性工具状态校验。

title: MedMCP-Calc: Benchmarking LLMs for Realistic Medical Calculator Scenarios via MCP Integration
authors: Yakun Zhu; Yutong Huang; Shengqian Qin; Zhongzhen Huang; Shaoting Zhang; Xiaofan Zhang
impact: 118 个真实计算场景显示模型在计算器选择、EHR 取数和 SQL 迭代上仍弱，临床数值任务需要代码工具而非文本推理。

title: LabSage: Structural-Semantic Decoupling for Enhanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Clinical Laboratories
authors: Hang Zhang; Yuelyu Ji; Chenyu Li; Hooman Rashidi; Sarah Wheeler; Yanshan Wang
impact: 检索小单元、推理扩展上下文的分层架构比固定切块提高答案准确率 8.3%、上下文召回 5.7%。
